items.title: Why Is Zimmer (ZBH) Up 1.8% Since Last Earnings Report?
items.summary: Zimmer (ZBH) reported earnings 30 days ago. What's next for the stock? We take a look at earnings estimates for some clues.

items.title: 1 Profitable Stock to Keep an Eye On and 2 That Underwhelm
items.summary: Not all profitable companies are built to last - some rely on outdated models or unsustainable advantages. Just because a business is in the green today doesn’t mean it will thrive tomorrow.

items.title: 1 Value Stock with Impressive Fundamentals and 2 We Question
items.summary: The low valuation multiples for value stocks provide a margin of safety that growth stocks rarely offer. However, the challenge lies in determining whether these cheap assets are genuinely undervalued or simply on sale due to their potentially deteriorating business models.

items.title: ISRG Stock: The Best House On The Block Costs The Most
items.summary: In the world of robotic surgery, one company is both the undisputed leader and the most expensive option, forcing investors to ask if operational excellence is worth the premium.

items.title: Can ISRG Stock Defend Its $131B Valuation?
items.summary: This is a market-broadening year for Intuitive Surgical. The company is expanding beyond its core da Vinci systems to serve a wider continuum of hospitals and surgery centers.

items.title: The Hospital Bet That Reframes The Intuitive Surgical Stock Story
items.summary: While investors fixate on a slowdown in current procedures, hospitals are accelerating their investment in the company's core platform, revealing a crucial, under-appreciated strength.

items.title: Intuitive Surgical Stock Has Fallen While Its Operating Margin Keeps Widening
items.summary: With US procedure growth slowing and the shares well below their high, the operating margin has widened in each of the last three years.

items.title: Is Zimmer Biomet Stock Worth Retaining in Your Portfolio Now?
items.summary: ZBH's growth outlook is backed by healthy procedure demand and Z1, HAMMR and OrthoGrid adoption, though debt and competition remain concerns.
